purpose: Six original editorial article covers; not portfolio projects.

prompts.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create ONE original editorial cover image for an interior design journal. Landscape 4:3 composition, high detail. Visual language: calm sophisticated contemporary apartment design, warm ivory plaster, smoked walnut and oak, tactile linen, understated travertine, dark bronze accents, restrained olive touches, soft natural window light and realistic shadows. Understated, artistic, architecturally plausible, refined imperfect material texture; no flashy marble, no gold glamour, no generic hotel lobby. Not a recreation of any real project. No words, letters, numbers, watermark, brand marks, infographic, split-screen or collage. Keep the main composition strong when cropped to a card. Theme: the cost and deliberate choices of an interior design project. A beautiful angled overhead editorial photograph of an architect's dark walnut desk: a generously spaced ivory architectural floor plan with only fine unlabeled lines, one closed sand-colored specification folio, a graphite pencil and a curated SMALL set of limestone, walnut and warm linen samples arranged in three considered groups. At the upper edge a curved cream chair and a sliver of softly lit room. Strong sculptural diagonal sunlight, quiet rich contrast. This is design budgeting and careful decisions, not finance; no coins, money, calculator, screens or readable text.
